population_definitions.train_role_minutes: Observed records assigned TRAIN by calendar date, before magnetic validity; not the eligible-window union or a complete calendar grid.
population_definitions.train_valid_magnetic_minutes: Training-role records with documented non-fill source and finite non-fill vector components; no amplitude cut.
population_definitions.minute_metadata: DBOT, PFN and point-count minute statistics use all valid training-role magnetic records, not only the eligible-window union.
population_definitions.eligible_bins_scanned: Distinct five-minute bins in the union of eligible stride-one four-hour training windows.
population_definitions.distinct_potential_target_bins: Distinct bins appearing at hidden positions in at least one eligible training window; not all eligible bins.
population_definitions.dbot_negative_minute_frac: dbot_negative_minutes / dbot_known_minutes; exact fills 999999 and 9999999 and nonfinite DBOT are missing.
population_definitions.bins_with_any_negative_dbot_frac: bins_with_any_negative_dbot / eligible_bins_scanned, including bins with missing DBOT in the denominator.
population_definitions.pfn_positive_frac_of_valid: pfn_positive_minutes / train_valid_magnetic_minutes, including missing PFN in the denominator; PFN fill 999 and nonfinite values never count as positive.
population_definitions.pfn_positive_frac_of_known: pfn_positive_minutes / pfn_known_minutes, excluding PFN fill 999 and nonfinite values.
population_definitions.one_point_frac_of_valid: Finite point counts <=1 / train_valid_magnetic_minutes; the existing counter includes zero, not only exactly one.
population_definitions.vector_magnitude: Quantiles of per-bin mean minute-vector magnitude over distinct eligible bins, one value per bin; not pooled minute magnitudes.
population_definitions.increment: Quantile of four consecutive one-minute vector increments within each eligible five-minute bin; excludes between-bin increments.
population_definitions.candidate_train_grid_starts: All UTC five-minute starts whose complete four hours lie in one TRAIN calendar month, before magnetic validity, missing-record or source checks.
population_definitions.eligible_start_frac_of_candidate_grid: eligible_train_starts / candidate_train_grid_starts; overlapping starts, not independent trajectories.

note: Read-only metadata scan. Metadata does not alter eligibility. DBOT/PFN are processing flags, not denoiser inputs or proof of invalid vectors.
